title: PRP for Sexual Function
official: Vaginal Injection of Platelet Rich Plasma for Sexual Dysfunction: A Randomized Control Trial
summary: This randomized, single-blinded, sham-controlled trial evaluates whether a single injection of autologous platelet-rich plasma (PRP) into the distal anterior vaginal wall improves sexual function in women with sexual dysfunction. Sixty participants with a Female Sexual Function Index (FSFI) total score of 26.5 or lower are randomized 1:1 to PRP injection or sterile saline injection. Sexual function, sexual distress, global impression of change, and urinary incontinence symptoms are assessed at baseline, 6 weeks, and 6 months after injection.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female, 18 years of age or older, presenting with sexual dysfunction
* FSFI total score ≤ 26.5
* English speaking and literate

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unwilling or unable to provide informed consent
* Pregnant or less than 12 weeks postpartum
* Known history of bleeding disorder
sponsor: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai
